title: After a redact widening, the local store's waiting entries are re-redacted so delivery does not stall
goal: querylog.py reredact [--store DIR], run by the operator, replaces each value the current redact rules flag in the local store's run files with its redacted form and drops only a fetch whose path the delivery's leak scan still flags; it writes a backup outside the store first and reports each change by file, line and field without the value; afterwards querylog.py check and the delivery's leak scan pass on the store; kb/_self/querylog.md's paragraph on a redact change that stalls delivery names querylog.py reredact as the remedy

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, json, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, glob
T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); S = os.path.join(T, "store")
shutil.copytree("_tools/fixtures/querylog/store", S)
RF = glob.glob(os.path.join(S, "2026-09", "*.jsonl"))[0]
lines = open(RF).read().splitlines()
MAIL = "anna.nowak" + chr(64) + "fabrikam" + ".com"
GUID = "-".join(["3f2a9c1e", "7b4d", "4e2a", "9c1f", "0a1b2c3d4e5f"])
rows = [json.loads(x) for x in lines]
rows[1]["question"] = "Why does the LAPS policy fail for " + MAIL + " on enrolment?"
CLEAN = {"tool": "WebFetch", "fetcher": "webfetch", "host": "learn.microsoft.com", "path": "/en-us/windows/laps", "outcome": "http-200", "n": 1}
rows[2]["fetches"] = [{"tool": "WebFetch", "fetcher": "webfetch", "host": "support.microsoft.com", "path": "/en-us/topic/smart-app-control-faq-" + GUID, "outcome": "http-200", "n": 1}, CLEAN]
PLANTS = ["AK" + "IA" + "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP", "gh" + "p_" + "a" * 36, "github" + "_pat_" + "a" * 22, "glp" + "at-" + "a" * 20,
          "glr" + "t-" + "a" * 20, "xo" + "xb-" + "1234567890", "sk-" + "ant-" + "a" * 20, "sk-" + "proj-" + "a" * 32,
          "Account" + "Key=" + "A" * 40, "?si" + "g=" + "a" * 30, "ey" + "J" + "a" * 10 + ".ey" + "J" + "a" * 10 + "." + "a" * 10,
          "PASS" + "WORD" + ' = "' + "hunter22xx" + '"', "db_pass" + "word=" + "Zq7" + "trellis9", "-----BEGIN " + "RSA PRIVATE KEY-----"]
rows[3]["question"] = "How is the LAPS password rotated? " + " ; ".join(PLANTS)
open(RF, "w").write("".join(json.dumps(r, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n" for r in rows))
before = open(RF).read()
ENV = dict(os.environ, KB_LIVE_DOCS="0")
r0 = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/querylog.py", "check", S], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV)
assert r0.returncode == 1, ("the planted store passes the store gates; the plant proves nothing", r0.stdout[-600:])
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import ql_store
REL = os.path.relpath(RF, S)
assert any("guid" in x for x in ql_store.leak_problems(S, [REL])), "the delivery's leak scan does not flag the planted GUID fetch path"
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/querylog.py", "reredact", "--store", S], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=300)
out = r.stdout + r.stderr
assert "Traceback" not in out, ("reredact crashes", out[-800:])
assert r.returncode == 0, ("querylog.py reredact --store does not run", r.returncode, out[-800:])
r1 = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/querylog.py", "check", S], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV)
assert r1.returncode == 0, ("the store gates still fail after reredact", r1.stdout[-800:])
left = ql_store.leak_problems(S, [REL])
assert not left, ("the delivery's leak scan still flags the run file after reredact", left)
after = [json.loads(x) for x in open(RF).read().splitlines()]
assert len(after) == len(rows), ("reredact added or removed an entry", len(rows), len(after))
assert MAIL not in after[1]["question"] and "on enrolment?" in after[1]["question"], ("the flagged value is not replaced in place", after[1]["question"])
assert GUID not in json.dumps(after[2]) and after[2].get("fetches") == [CLEAN], ("not only the GUID fetch path is dropped", after[2].get("fetches"))
survived = [x for x in PLANTS if x in json.dumps(after[3]) or x in out]
assert not survived, ("a planted secret survives reredact in the store or its report", survived)
assert after[3]["question"].startswith("How is the LAPS password rotated?"), ("reredact did not keep the clean words of a flagged value", after[3]["question"][:200])
assert after[4:] == rows[4:] and after[0] == rows[0], "reredact changed an entry the rules do not flag"
bk = [l.split(":", 1)[1].strip() for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith("backup:")]
assert bk and os.path.exists(bk[0]), ("reredact names no backup it wrote", out[-600:])
held = "".join(open(p).read() for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(bk[0], "**", "*.jsonl"), recursive=True)) if os.path.isdir(bk[0]) else open(bk[0]).read()
assert MAIL in held, "the backup does not hold the original run file"
assert os.path.realpath(bk[0]).startswith(os.path.realpath(S) + os.sep) is False, "the backup sits inside the store, where the store gates read it"
assert "question" in out and "fetches" in out and MAIL not in out, ("reredact does not report each change by its field, or prints the value it replaced", out[-600:])

import sys
t = open("kb/_self/querylog.md", encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()
para = [l for l in t if l.startswith("- **A redact change stalls delivery.**")]
assert para, "the Delivery paragraph 'A redact change stalls delivery' is gone"
sys.exit(0 if "querylog.py reredact" in para[0] else 1)
